name: Aiguafreda (Spain)
description: The upper half red strewn with white crosslets, of which three are complete, the lower half divided into two equal stripes, yellow above black.
history: The official flag was approved on 11 December 1997 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2555 of 13 January 1998; it is described as an oblong flag of 2:3 with the upper half red strewn with white crosslets, only three of which are complete, and the lower half composed of two equal stripes, yellow and black.

features.role: crosslets strewn on the red, three of them whole
